stemMd: Five seats are in a row. Eva sits in the middle. Finn sits immediately to Eva’s right. Gia sits at an end and next to Hal. Ira takes the remaining seat. Who sits in the first seat from the left?
explanationMd: Eva and Finn occupy seats 3 and 4. Gia cannot take seat 5 because her neighbour would then be Finn, not Hal. Thus Gia is in seat 1, Hal in seat 2 and Ira in seat 5.

distractorRationale.d: Hal must be next to Gia at the available left end pair.
distractorRationale.e: Ira occupies the only remaining right-end seat.
distractorRationale.a: Eva is fixed in the middle seat.
distractorRationale.c: Finn is fixed immediately right of the middle.
